model.name: 851 Labs Background Remover
model.shortDescription: Cut out any subject in one click. Open-source InSPyReNet gives clean edges on hair, fur, and glass, output as a transparent PNG, white, green screen, or blurred background.

inputs.description: The image you want to remove the background from.
inputs.label: Image
inputs.name: image

inputs.description: Controls how sharply the subject is cut out. At 0, edges are soft and natural (good for hair or fur); higher values give a harder, cleaner-edged cutout.
inputs.label: Threshold
inputs.name: threshold

inputs.description: Removes the subject instead of the background, keeping the background only.
inputs.label: Reverse
inputs.name: reverse

inputs.description: What to put behind the subject: Transparent (see-through), a solid color like white or green screen, a blurred version of the original, or an overlay. Map returns the cutout mask itself.
inputs.label: Background Type
inputs.name: backgroundType
